portal.title: Dvarpala VPN - Authentication Required
portal.subtitle: Zero Trust VPN Gateway
portal.welcome_message: Welcome to the secure network. Please authenticate with your organization's identity provider to gain access.
portal.session_info: After successful authentication, you will receive full network access until you disconnect from the VPN.

auth_success.title: Authentication Successful!
auth_success.subtitle: You now have full network access

auth_error.title: Authentication Failed
auth_error.subtitle: Access denied
auth_error.default_message: You are not authorized to access this VPN. Please contact your administrator.
possible_reasons: Your email address is not authorized for VPN access
Your account has been suspended or deactivated
next_steps: Contact your system administrator to request VPN access
Verify your email address is correct
Try again with a different OAuth provider
Check if your organization account is active
